page: Vultr voc-g-24c-96gb-480s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server instance powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs derived from 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is provided by a 480 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. No GPU hardware is present on this instance.

In benchmark evaluations, this instance demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 10% in stress-ng testing. Multi-core CPU performance is strong, ranking in the top 25%. Memory performance is also notable, with the Passmark memory score placing in the top 25%, while raw memory read and write bandwidth tests fall within the average range. For specialized workloads, the server achieves top-tier performance in text generation for small language models, though medium model inference and database operations perform at average levels.

From a resource-density perspective, the dedicated AMD EPYC cores and integrated NVMe storage deliver a highly stable performance profile for multi-threaded applications without the overhead of specialized accelerator hardware. This makes the instance a cost-effective option for workloads requiring sustained CPU utilization. Suitable workloads include general-purpose web serving, software compilation, medium-scale database operations, and text-based language model inference.
